vocabulary.definition: beliefs or practices resulting from ignorance, fear of the unknown, trust in magic or chance, or a false conception of causation
vocabulary.example: Many people have superstitions like avoiding walking under ladders or believing in lucky charms.

vocabulary.definition: to drive or force back; to keep away
vocabulary.example: Citronella candles are used to repel mosquitoes during outdoor gatherings.

vocabulary.definition: a broad or general term that is used to cover a range of related items or situations
vocabulary.example: In psychology, 'anxiety disorder' is a blanket term that includes various specific conditions like panic disorder and social anxiety.

vocabulary.definition: the combined qualities of taste and smell perceived in a substance or food
vocabulary.example: The chef added a variety of spices to enhance the flavors of the curry.

vocabulary.definition: to summarize or review key points or events
vocabulary.example: Before the exam, the teacher will recap the main topics covered throughout the semester.

vocabulary.definition: events where people come together in a group
vocabulary.example: Family gatherings during holidays are a time for sharing stories and creating memories.
